subscriptions.title: Marketplaces
subscriptions.name: Name
subscriptions.pubKey: Public key — optional; pins trust (verifies the catalog signature before install)
subscriptions.pubKeyPlaceholder: paste the publisher's minisign key line, e.g. RWQ…
subscriptions.none: No marketplaces yet — add one above.

sidecars.doctorTitle: What each installed item still needs
sidecars.search: Search sidecars by name, title, or description…
sidecars.none: No sidecars. Add a marketplace (Marketplaces, above) to browse items.
sidecars.devBuildHint: Built from a checkout and installed by make dev (the dev channel): make dev updates it
sidecars.storeKeptHint: Version {{version}} from a marketplace is kept in the store, for the universes that pin it
sidecars.replaceDev: Replace the dev build in {{universe}} with

seeds.title: Project templates — a universe's starting content
seeds.hint: A project template is a project (its objects, documents and files) and its tasks. It applies to the universe on screen; a universe serves one project.
seeds.none: No project template offered by your marketplaces. A publisher creates one with ktw-compose, or a snapshot publishes its own.
seeds.projectDirHint: A new folder for the project (default: beside the universe).
seeds.differs: Members at another version than the project template was made with: {{members}}

infra.title: Control plane
infra.whatUpdate: Move the control plane from {{from}} to {{to}}.
infra.whatRollback: Roll the control plane back from {{from}} to {{to}}.
infra.whatRepair: Place every control-plane binary again from the channel ({{version}}).
infra.whatAlign: Align the control plane to {{to}}, the version {{name}} was made with (now {{from}}). Then create the universe from Project templates.
infra.sidecarsElsewhere: Only the control plane moves here; sidecars update in the Sidecars tab.
infra.snapshotsHint: A solution pins everything, the control plane's version included. Align the control plane to it first, then install it (Solutions).
infra.noSnapshots: No solution offered by your marketplaces.
infra.notOnChannel: infra {{version}} is not on the channel
infra.machineWide: This is machine-wide: every universe of this machine runs on this control plane. The window closes, the control plane moves with nothing running, and the new version opens.
infra.relaunchUnavailable: This window cannot hand off — run {{cmd}} from a terminal
infra.devHint: Built from a checkout and installed by make dev (the dev channel): make dev updates it, not this channel.
infra.replaceDev: Replace the dev build with {{version}} & restart
infra.whatReplaceDev: Replace the control plane's dev build ({{from}}) with {{to}} from the channel.

solutions.title: Solutions — fixed versions of a working installation
solutions.hint: A solution pins the infra version, the sidecars at their versions, its config-sets, its project template and its vaults, and delivers its documents in each language.
solutions.none: No solution offered by your marketplaces. A publisher makes one with ktw-compose snapshot-universe.
solutions.installHint: Into a new universe (or one by its name): its vaults opened with their passwords, the keys its config-sets need, its project and documents.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.hint: Sealed keys files your marketplaces offer, each opened with its password.

keysRestart.hint: {{universe}} is running: its programs read their keys when they start. Restart it to use the new keys.

configsets.noHome: No universe selected, or its home folder is unknown — refusing to apply.
configsets.none: No config-sets offered by your marketplaces. A publisher creates one with
configsets.applyHint: Drops this set's templates into the universe and collects the keys they need. Safe to repeat — re-applying is how you pick up a new version.
configsets.forceHint: Overwrite templates that are already present in this universe
configsets.blankHint: Leave a field blank to keep its current value; every key not marked optional needs one. Applying again is how you pick up a new version — there is no separate update.
